email.subject: Quick fix for Northwind Plumbing's site
email.body:
Jack,

Checked your site for Northwind Plumbing. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors have to copy and dial manually, and your hours aren't listed, so people searching after-hours can't tell if you're open for emergencies. Easy fixes, probably not visitors looking elsewhere.

I run Northlight Web, fixing stuff like this for local businesses for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found in a free 10-minute call, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
